similar_known_concepts.name: Ember-style temperature-sensing smart mug
similar_known_concepts.why_similar: Both concepts monitor the temperature of a liquid and communicate the reading to a smartphone via Bluetooth, enabling real-time temperature awareness for the user.
similar_known_concepts.differences: The Ember-style concept is a mug with heating control and a focus on keeping liquid at a target temperature, whereas the invention is a bottle without necessarily active heating control.

similar_known_concepts.name: Bluetooth-enabled beverage thermometer (generic)
similar_known_concepts.why_similar: Directly uses a sensor to measure liquid temperature and transmits the measurement to a smartphone over Bluetooth, matching the core data path.
similar_known_concepts.differences: May be a standalone sensor or probe rather than integrated into a bottle, and might lack an integrated app or bottle-specific form factor.

analysis.similarity_explanation: The invention shares the core idea of measuring liquid temperature and delivering the reading to a smartphone over Bluetooth, which is present in known concepts like temperature-sensing smart mugs and Bluetooth beverage thermometers. Differences include bottle form factor and the absence of explicit heating control or additional beverage-management features in the described invention.
